note.en: Generated by GLM-5.3 Flash (high reasoning effort) running inside the WorkBuddy agent environment. A complete React + TypeScript + three.js Vite project, written continuously in a single session from the repository's canonical Chinese prompt: 216 seconds total (within the 360-second hard cap), voxel/block-geometry art, adapting the passage of Zhang Beihai assassinating the old-spaceflight establishment — four acts (study dialogue, station airlock, vacuum EVA assassination, epilogue) with camera blocking and easing. All voice content lives in one structured voiceCues list (id/kind/speaker/text/delivery/start/end), subtitles rendered as centered bottom-of-frame speaker-tagged text; vacuum physics respected: no direct gunshot sound in space, only suit-conducted muffled thumps and subjective low-frequency rumble, with all other effects (machinery, depressurization, alarm, thrusters, ambient pad) synthesized via Web Audio. Note: due to environment limits (no Bun) the code was not verified with bun run build; the run-watch-correct loop from the prompt was not performed.
